en.text: John can't bear the noise.

original: こんなことにはもう我慢がならない。

en.text: I couldn't stand it anymore.

original: 「キスは駄目って言ったじゃん！」「ごめん、我慢できなかった」

en.text: "I said no kissing!" "Sorry, I couldn't resist."

original: なんでいつも私ばっかり我慢しなきゃいけないの？

en.text: Why am I always the one who has to suffer?

original: トムはメアリーのマナーの悪さに、もうこれ以上我慢できないんだ。

en.text: Tom can't put up with Mary's bad manners any longer.

original: もうね、我慢できなかったの。

en.text: I couldn't stand it anymore.

original: この痛さ、これ以上我慢できないよ。

en.text: I can't bear the pain anymore.

original: おしっこ我慢してると膀胱炎になっちゃうよ。

en.text: If you hold your pee, you'll get cystitis.

original: 彼のあの態度には我慢できないんだよ。

en.text: I can't stand that attitude of his.

original: どうやって我慢するの？

en.text: How do you put up with it?

original: 彼はもはやそれを我慢できない。

en.text: He can't put up with it anymore.

original: トムには我慢できない。

en.text: I can't put up with Tom.

original: 旅行には行きたいけど、今回は我慢するよ。

en.text: I do want to go on the trip, but I'll hold off this time.

original: 足のしびれを我慢していたため、立ち上がろうとした途端によろめいてしまった。

en.text: Since my leg was numb, I stumbled as soon as I tried to stand up.

original: 僕に我慢してくれてありがとう。

en.text: Thank you for tolerating me.

original: 「さっきの授業、寝てたでしょ」「うん。我慢できなくてね。先生気づいてそうだった？」「それは、大丈夫そうだったけど、思いっきり船漕いでるから、男の子たち笑ってたよ」「うわっ。その方が嫌かも」

en.text: "I guess you just slept through our last class." "Yeah, I wasn't able to keep myself awake any longer. Do you think the teacher noticed?" "They didn't seem to notice, but you completely dozed off, so all the boys were laughing about it." "Yikes. That's probably even worse."

original: ちょっと我慢して。

en.text: Just be patient.

original: 歯医者さんに行ったらさ、「痛かったら、手を上げてください」って言うから、正直に手を上げたら「ちょっと我慢して」って流されたんだけど、あれって何の意味があるのかな？

en.text: When I went to the dentist, he told me to raise my hand whenever it hurt, but when I did he waved me off and told me to hang on a minute. So what was the point of him telling me that earlier?

original: 「昨夜、猫の鳴き声がうるさくて寝れなかったよ」「一緒一緒。私も、目が覚めたよ」「隣のおっちゃん、我慢できなかったんだろうね。『うるさい！』って叫んだから、猫は逃げってったんだけど、今度はその声にびっくりして寝れなくなってさ、参ったよ」

en.text: "I couldn't sleep last night because that cat wouldn't shut up with its meowing." "Same. I woke up, too." "And apparently my neighbor couldn't take it anymore either. When he yelled at the cat to shut up, it ran away, but I was so startled I couldn't go back to sleep."

original: ああいう奴が我慢できない。

en.text: I can't stand guys like that.

original: もう、我慢できるかわかんないよ。

en.text: I don't know if I can take it anymore.

original: トイレに行ってもいいですか？もう我慢できないんです。

en.text: Can I please go to the bathroom? It's an emergency.

original: 正月太りが解消されないから、我慢しようと思ってはいるんだけど、ついついチョコに手が伸びちゃうのよね。

en.text: Although I still haven't been able to lose the weight I gained over New Year's, I've not been able to keep myself away from chocolate, as much as I've been trying to resist it.

original: あの音に我慢できる？

en.text: Can you put up with the noise?

original: あいつには、もう我慢できない。

en.text: I can't stand him any longer.

original: 我慢できません。

en.text: I can't stand them.

original: もうちょっと我慢して。

en.text: Be a little more patient!
Hang on just a little longer!

original: よくこんな音に我慢できるね。

en.text: How can you stand all these noises?

original: それぐらいの遅れなら我慢できる。

en.text: If you are only this late, I can put up with it.

original: もうちょっと我慢できそう？

en.text: Can you hold it a bit longer?
